# nash

nash is a modern descendant of `sh`, written in Rust. It runs your existing
sh/bash scripts, takes the best interactive ideas from zsh and adds a few of
its own. The only dependency is `libc`.

## Latest

| channel | version | released | get it |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| stable | [0.1.0.7](https://github.com/fourtexec/nash/releases/tag/v0.1.0.7) | 2026-11-15 | `nash update` |
| dev | [dev14](https://github.com/fourtexec/nash/releases/tag/dev14) | 2026-11-15 | `nash update dev` |

## Install

```sh
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fourtexec/nash/main/install.sh | sh
```

## Update

nash updates itself from the [release manifest](https://fourtexec.site/nash/manifest.json)
of this site: it takes the binary tagged with your system and CPU, checks its
SHA-256 and replaces itself.

```sh
nash update          # the newest stable release
nash update dev      # the newest development build
nash update 0.1.0.7  # exactly that release
nash update --list   # what there is for your system
```
